title: LightOnOCR-3 Hits Top Spot on ParseBench for Open Weight AI
summary:
A new family of AI models for document recognition released by LightOn allows businesses to turn handwriting, images and charts into machine-readable content in a single processing step. The LightOnOCR-3 tools, which are available in 0.8B, 1B and 4B parameter sizes, can transcribe text and identify document layouts while preserving the original structure of financial reports and technical files.

The models are released under an Apache 2.0 license for deployment on private infrastructure and are up to twice as fast as the previous LightOnOCR-2 version. In benchmark tests, the company reports that LightOnOCR-3 is the leading open weight model on ParseBench and outperforms Mistral OCR 4.1, Chandra-OCR-2 and dots.mocr on the OlmOCR-Bench.

World-leading document recognition. Beyond text extraction. 

Introducing LightOnOCR-3, our new family of state-of-the-art AI models for document intelligence. 
Building on LightOnOCR-2, it recognizes text and handwriting, describes images, extracts data from charts and preserves document structure, all in a single processing step. 

🏆 Leading benchmark results : ahead of Chandra-OCR-2, Mistral OCR 4.1 and dots.mocr on OlmOCR-Bench, and first among open-weight models on ParseBench.

 📊 More information from every document : turn text, tables, images and charts into content your business applications can use. 

⚡Compact and efficient: 0.8B and 4B versions, with document processing up to twice as fast as LightOnOCR-2. 

🔓Apache 2.0 license: use, adapt and deploy the models on your own infrastructure. 

From handwritten administrative files to financial reports and technical documents, make more of your information searchable and usable.
